title: Freeze the Pre-ObserverOS execution phase plan
prohibited_actions: No interface implementation, ObserverOS repository change, network API, database, credential, media, deployment, business fixture, business calculation, AI result, or permission decision
No modification to the frozen V7 baseline or existing admitted OTP artifacts
No claim that planned interface names are existing ObserverOS APIs
acceptance: Plan defines the bounded no-ObserverOS phase, its entry and exit gates, and a complete ordered OTP list
Every planned OTP declares task, objective, output, expected result, constraints, deliverables, audit, and verification
Plan separates Mock-only PASS from HOLD_LIVE_INTEGRATION and identifies all non-deferrable real-ObserverOS gates
Verification confirms every planned OTP ID and required governance heading is present
Typecheck, production build, control-plane validation, GitHub audit, and receipt pass
